title: Mall World Zine
content: The following is a zine I made based on a dream of what I can only describe as a Mall World dream. Inside the elaborate mall from my dream is a section of play places similar to the indoor extravaganza zip-line adventure course style facilities where you can climb, aided by a carabiner and tether system of metal cables and ropes. In my dream there was a monster that I imagined as being this king kong sized yeti with incredible speed and hearing along with a supernatural ability to know where we (the dream me plus the dream people I was accompanied by) were at any given point if too much sound was made. I am aware that you can’t actually hear in dreams and any sound I did hear was imaginary.
